description: Deterministic click, auto-wait, and asynchronous UI update flow.
promptTemplate: Use the {{DRIVER_SKILL}} skill and {{DRIVER_LABEL}} CLI for every browser interaction. Open a fresh {{BROWSER_MODE}} Chrome session, navigate to {{BASE_URL}}/, click the visible Check deployment button, wait for the status update to become visible, and return the final status text and current URL as message and url.
